anchors.meaning: Reward object kind3 selects the manual branch; other kinds use automatic allocation.
Reward phase8 repeats capacity-limited five-point allocation while EXP permits; manual branch stops at UI.
Fresh-object flag20000000 enters initialization and clears the flag before external resource setup.
Fresh AI object passes source packed adjustment words to40e870 after resource setup.
Player-object counterpart passes the same source words; kind3 bypasses random adjustment in40e870.
General actor callback adjusts under global4000000 and actAdjustAllPlayerLevel latch.
Player callback uses the same phase/latch gate for all-roster adjustment.
Opcode73 sets a yielding VM phase and the global adjustment latch.
Resuming opcode73 resets the phase and global adjustment latch.
Player magic learning dispatches on job and stored level plus one, preserving existing masks.
Special learning checks class tier and four base attributes in source table order; at most one new skill per call.
Live-job special learning selects its source table and class tier.
Magic grant writes its missing bit and generates a message; repeat is a no-op.
Special nonnull message buffer previews without granting; null buffer commits the first eligible missing bit.
Magic learner is called by the player level-up message object, separately from automatic NPC allocation.
Player special preview and later null-buffer commit use the same learning helper.

limits: Reward phase8 is full return for NPC/no-growth, manual positive-growth stops before UI436490.
Learning helpers execute normally using synthetic string/name pointers. Whole player UI callback is not emulated.
Magic uses job and stored level+1; special uses base attributes/tier and one missing bit per call. NPC automatic allocation does not invoke either learner.
Initial gates stop before subsequent actor actions; full resource creation and renderer timing remain separate.
The original entry helper uses the global native RNG. The remake saved initialization stream remains explicitly separate from combat/reward streams.
